allowPermissionsDesc: Suñu ko amalee, bépp wootu jumtukaayu MCP dina ñu ko nangu ci saasi te du wane dialog yiy may ndigal. Jekkal bii dafay tënku ci bépp waxtaan, ba ci waxtaan yu bees yi.

runtimeSettings.title: Runtime Settings
runtimeSettings.description: Taxawal ni Novera di yoree ak di jéemaat serveur MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Diir bi gëna mag ngir xaar tontu jumtukaay MCP balaa waxtu bi di jeex.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Jumtukaay bi gëna gudd biñ denc ci waxtaan wi. Lépp lu weesu lii dañu koy dagg ba noppi màrkee ko ni dafa dagg, kon benn resultaa bu rëy mënul jeexal contexte model bi. Set to 0 to keep results whole.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Suñu ko tëyee, Novera dafay tànn serveur MCP yi laata muy jëfandikoo jumtukaay yi. Deactivé ngir sarse saa yu nekk limu jumtukaayi MCP yépp.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Jëfandikool ab model buñ jagleel yoon wi
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Sudee smart routing tafu, defal jéego routing bi ak model bu wuute (bu gëna ndaw) ci barabu model chat bi. Def ko ngir jëfandikoo saa yu nekk model chat biy dox ngir routing.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Tannal furnisër ak model ci benn barab. Modèle yu woyof yi kese lañu lim ngir routing bi gëna gaaw te yomb.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: No lightweight models available. Yokk benn model bu gëna ndaw wala nga defar caabi API ci Model yi.
